title: Quaint Malty Slovakian Ovoli Mushroom Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian dish featuring ovoli mushrooms, perfect for a date night, made with malty and juicy ingredients, and Whole30 friendly.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork sausage and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ovoli mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the malt syrup and chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the liquid has reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
